episodes.title: Maine Supreme Court gives father final say on daughter's religious involvement
episodes.description: Attorneys are reacting to a Maine high court ruling that upheld the father's final decision-making power in his daughter's involvement at Calvary Chapel in Westbrook

episodes.title: Attorneys from both sides of a parental rights case are speaking out
episodes.description: Matthew Bradeen requested sole authority after the mother took their daughter to Calvary Chapel without his knowledge.

episodes.title: Segway inventor steps down over Jeffrey Epstein association
episodes.description: Dean Kamen resigned from an electric plane company's board of directors after he appeared in recently released Epstein files.

episodes.title: Maine mom says district court ruling violates parental, religious rights
episodes.description: Emily Bickford is taking her case to the Maine Supreme Court after a ruling stated her daughter's father had the right to restrict the girl from attending church.

episodes.title: Maine Supreme Court hears arguments in case on religious freedom and parental rights
episodes.description: The case was brought by a woman who believes a lower court overreached when it gave her co-parent veto power over what church their daughter could attend.
